nodes.title: Adversarial review 'money, approvals and auth': 10 reproduced defects (1 blocker, 5 major, 4 minor), each a failing test on the code reviewed; the ledger, approval replay/binding/expiry, wallet credit and IST boundaries checked sound.
nodes.method: Reviewer read the kernel, money and workspace. Each claim became a todo test in product/tests/review/money-auth.test.ts on a throwaway Postgres 16. Details in money-auth.md.
nodes.value: 1 blocker / 5 major / 4 minor; kernel MA-01, 03, 04, 05, 06 fixed by the main loop the same day

nodes.title: The kernel granted A3 (run at once) by actor type: any 'agent' ran attempt.retry_per_ladder, which re-dials a person, without a tap, though members asking for it got a card.
nodes.broke: The Operator acts for a member as an 'agent' carrying that member's role, so a chat turn, or text injected into an upload, could re-dial anyone with no human tap. Rule: approval follows the principal, not the actor type. An agent with a member's role is held exactly as that member. Only system and role-less agents are autonomous. One function, heldForApproval in server/tools.ts, decides for both the registry and the Operator's plan view.

nodes.title: Login and sign-up throttles were keyed on the raw X-Forwarded-For header, which the client controls.
nodes.broke: Rotating the header gave unlimited password guesses: 12 wrong passwords, 12 times 401, no 429. Rule: throttle per account, counting failures only, and per client address. The address comes from clientIp() in server/http.ts: the socket peer, or the right-most X-Forwarded-For hop that is not a trusted proxy (loopback and private ranges by default; VP_TRUSTED_PROXIES=none to trust none).

events.event: Kernel fixes for the money/auth review: MA-01, 03, 04, 05, 06
events.details: heldForApproval (agents with a member's role are held like the member; the Operator plan view uses the same rule). decline() requires canApprove or the proposer. Cookie mutations need a media-type essence of exactly application/json, and Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site or same-site is refused. Login throttles per account (failures) and per clientIp. /v1/actions and /v1/audit/verify are scope-checked for API keys. Suite: 304 tests, 290 pass, 0 fail, 14 todo. MA-02, 07, 10 routed to workspace; MA-08, 09 to money.
